entities.summary: Alison Mary Blake,, is a British diplomat who served as Governor of the Falkland Islands and Commissioner of South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands from 2022 to 2025. She previously served as High Commissioner to Bangladesh and Ambassador to Afghanistan.
